runner_page.lead: Let your assistant run commands on <0>your machine</0> (the computer in front of you), even behind a home network. You install a small program that dials into {brand}; nothing opens a port on your computer.
runner_page.unverified: {brand} Runner is not verified by Apple or Microsoft yet, so your system will show a security warning.
runner_page.step1_lead: This code links the app to your account. It appears only once; keep this tab open, you will paste it into the app in a moment.
runner_page.code_warning: Keep this code to yourself. It grants execution access to your machine while the app is open. If it leaks, revoke it in <0>your codes</0> below.
runner_page.step2_lead: Download the {brand} Runner app and open it. It opens a window in your browser for you to paste the code; no terminal or commands needed. After that, just leave it running.
runner_page.advanced: Other system or advanced mode (command line)
runner_page.cli_mode: CLI mode expects the code in <0/> and runs in the terminal (without opening the panel). Set the starting folder with <1/>.
runner_page.step3_title: 3. Paste the code into the panel
runner_page.step3_lead: When you open the app, a browser tab shows the {brand} Runner panel. Paste the code from step 1 there and click <0>Connect</0>. The indicator above turns green once it connects. Done: you can close the tab, it keeps running (to stop it, use <1>Quit</1> in the panel).
runner_page.step4_lead: With the app green above, just ask in the chat, for example: <0>“run <0/> on my machine”</0>. The one operating the machine is the assistant shown in the status above; to switch, go to <1>Connections → {brand} Runner</1>. A <2>group</2> assistant cannot operate the Runner (a group is a channel with several people, the Runner is your machine).
runner_page.footer: {brand} · the runner runs commands only while you keep it open.
runner_page.mac_app_unzip: The file downloads and the Mac unzips it automatically: you get the <0>{brand} Runner</0> app in your Downloads folder.
runner_page.mac_app_open: <0>Double-click</0> the app. macOS will warn that it could not open it (the app does not have a digital signature yet). Click <1>OK</1> on that warning.
runner_page.mac_app_allow: Open <0>System Settings › Privacy & Security</0>. Scroll to the <1>Security</1> section: you will see the message saying that <2>{brand} Runner</2> was blocked, with the <3>Open Anyway</3> button. Click it.
runner_page.mac_app_confirm: Confirm with <0>Open</0> and unlock with your password or Touch ID. (Only the first time.)
runner_page.panel_opens: A browser tab opens with the {brand} Runner panel. Follow step 3.
runner_page.windows_allow: If you see <0>“Windows protected your PC”</0>, click <1>More info</1> › <2>Run anyway</2>. (Only the first time.)
runner_page.linux_executable: In the terminal, inside the folder with the file, make it executable:
runner_page.keep_running: Leave it running. Ctrl-C to stop.
runner_page.cli_folder: Open <0>Terminal</0> and go to the folder with the file (e.g.: <1/>).
runner_page.outdated: Runner out of date. Download it again below (version {version}) so you can transfer files from your machine.

wizard_type.what_do_want_call: What do you want to call your assistant?
wizard_type.complete_assistant_does_everything: It is your complete assistant: it does everything and uses every tool you connect. Later, if you want, you can create other, more focused assistants.

wizard_connect.assistant_can_help_organize: Your assistant can help you organize your day.
wizard_connect.connect_calendar_suggestions_based: Connect your calendar for suggestions based on your events. You can also connect your email if you like.
wizard_connect.choose_what_share_can: You choose what to share and can revoke access at any time.
wizard_connect.learn_more_about_access: Learn more about access and security
wizard_connect.connecting_calendar_allows_reading: Connecting your calendar allows reading your events and creating, editing or deleting events. The first analysis aims to suggest how to organize your day.
wizard_connect.email_access_requested_only: Email access is requested only if you select the option above. This allows reading messages and creating drafts in Google or sending messages with Microsoft. We do not request Drive or OneDrive access at this step.
wizard_connect.previously_granted_permissions_may: Previously granted permissions may remain active. You can disconnect in Connections and revoke permissions in your Google or Microsoft account. Trying without connecting uses the context you write, or sources you have already connected.

wizard_wow.let_me_get_know: Let me get to know you… 🔍
wizard_wow.preparing_suggestions_using_information: Preparing suggestions using the information you chose to share. You can continue later without losing this step.
wizard_wow.first_look_at_context: A first look at your context
wizard_wow.first_result_without_connecting: Your first result, without connecting email
wizard_wow.choose_something_useful_share: Choose something useful and share the context. We will only use what you write here, without accessing accounts or sending messages.
wizard_wow.share_little_context_with: Share a little context with your assistant
wizard_wow.e_g_i_have: E.g. I have three deliverables tomorrow, two meetings, and need to decide where to start.
wizard_wow.generation_uses_plan_credits: Generation uses your plan credits. Nothing will be sent or scheduled.

wizard_whatsapp.result_saved_can_connect: Your result is saved. You can connect WhatsApp to continue there, or keep using the app.
wizard_whatsapp.whatsapp_with_country_area: Your WhatsApp (with country and area code)
wizard_whatsapp.i_want_get_exchange: I want to get and exchange messages with my assistant on WhatsApp.
wizard_whatsapp.number_connected_now_tap: ✅ Number connected! Now tap below and send the <0>first message</0> to your assistant. That is what opens the chat on WhatsApp (without it, it still cannot reply to you).

home.write_here_what_need: Write here what you need your assistant to do…

assistants.name: Name
assistants.describe_her_role_e: Describe her role. E.g.: 'You are a personal shopper, you find real products for sale and help choose and buy.' Leave blank for a general assistant.

memory.memory_shared_across_all: Memory is <0>shared</0> across all your assistants: it is what they know about you.
memory.pick_page_left_or: Pick a page on the left or create a new one.
memory.title: Title

prompt.defines_how_assistant_acts: Defines how the assistant acts and talks. The changes apply from the next turn on.
prompt.name: Name
prompt.one_line_what: In one line, what it is for
prompt.what_should_do_how: What it should do, how it should behave, what it knows about you...
prompt.how_talks_formal_direct: How it talks: formal, direct, good-humored, in English...
prompt.personal_assistant_1_1: Personal assistant (1:1, full toolset with confirmation)
prompt.purpose_agent_group_channel: Purpose agent in a group (channel with several people, controlled toolset)
prompt.super_agent_live_terminal: Super agent (live terminal, needs a connected server)
prompt.tools_allowed_this_group: Tools allowed for this group agent
prompt.group_agent_never_accesses: A group agent never accesses the owner’s personal account, does not reconfigure itself and does not create access to new servers, even with the shell on.
prompt.let_external_system_trigger: Let an external system trigger a skill of this assistant through an authenticated call. The system says which skill to run and sends the data; the assistant replies asynchronously.
prompt.token_copy_now_only: Token (copy it now, it only shows this once)

connections.connect_google_account_give: Connect your Google account to give your agents access to Gmail, Drive and Docs (read-only).
connections.can_connect_more_than: You can connect more than one Google account. On the next step Google lets you choose which account to add. Each agent uses one account.
connections.connect_github_slack_so: Connect GitHub and Slack so your assistants can read repositories, issues and messages.
connections.connect_agent_telegram_can: Connect an agent to Telegram. You can connect several: each agent needs its <0>own bot</0> (one BotFather token per agent).
connections.choose_name_username_change: Choose a <0>name</0> and a <1>@username</1> (you change the avatar later with <2>/setuserpic</2>).
connections.gives_token_paste_below: It gives you a <0>token</0>. Paste it below.
connections.which_agent_replies_this: Which agent replies in this bot?
connections.talk_assistant_slack_pick: Talk to an assistant on Slack. Pick the assistant, generate a code and, in the channel or DM where you want it, send <0>conectar CÓDIGO</0>. You can have one assistant in one channel and another in another. (The {brand} app needs to be installed in your Slack workspace.)
connections.which_assistant_answers_this: Which assistant answers on this code?
connections.choose_which_assistant_replies: Choose which assistant replies in the Chrome extension. In the extension chat you can still talk to another one on the spot by sending <0>@name</0>.
connections.which_assistant_replies_extension: Which assistant replies in the extension?
connections.public_service_lead: One of your assistants replies to anyone who writes to this installation's WhatsApp number without an account. Set it up, see the chats, and block or delete contacts.
connections.number_with_country_area: Your number (with country and area code)
connections.i_want_exchange_messages: I want to exchange messages with my assistant on WhatsApp.
connections.store_api_keys_tokens: Store API keys and tokens from other services. They stay <0>encrypted</0> in our vault and are only used the moment your assistant needs them. You can remove them at any time.
connections.connect_app_store_connect: Connect your App Store Connect account so your assistant can read the <0>TestFlight crashes</0> of your app, on demand (you ask, it lists, you choose which ones to process). The key <1/> stays <2>encrypted</2> in the vault; it never shows up in the chat.
connections.e_g_f8fwq3z6f6_same: e.g. F8FWQ3Z6F6 (the same one in the file name AuthKey_XXXX.p8)

skills.apps_assistants_built_published: Apps your assistants built for you, published at your own web address. You can publish them in the public {brand} library.
skills.skill_way_doing_something: A Skill is a way of doing something that you teach once and the assistant starts reusing (e.g.: "build the shopping list", "review a contract"). Ask the assistant to create it, edit it or share it with a contact.
skills.skills_ready_verified_by: Skills ready and verified by us. Install it in one tap and it starts working in the chats with your assistant.
skills.search_skills_by_name: Search skills by name or topic...
skills.space_topic_keep_going: A Space is a topic you keep going together with whoever you invite (e.g.: plants, house shopping). Each Space has a <0>mode</0> that decides what the assistant shares in it.

contacts.connect_with_another_person: Connect with another person on {brand} so your assistant can talk to theirs (coordinate schedules, exchange some info). It only works when the invite is accepted on both sides.

files.documents_media_assistant_generated: Documents and media your assistant generated or received are stored here, in your private library. Tap an item to download it.

settings.place_where_agents_publish: It is the place where your agents publish content for you to access from anywhere and share with friends and family. Pick your username (it has to be unique).
settings.generate_videos_with_face: To generate videos with your face, send a photo of yourself <0>front-facing, well lit, only you in the frame</0>. This photo becomes the official reference for your account, and every video is generated from it (that is why nobody can use someone else’s face). 18+ only.
settings.want_face_come_out: Want the face to come out more like you? Send <0>2 more photos of you</0> at different angles (e.g.: from the side and a bit from above), always <1>only you in the frame</1>. It is optional; it helps the AI rebuild your features better.
settings.record_short_clip_voice: Record a short clip of your voice (about 10 to 20 seconds, speaking naturally). It becomes the base of your voice in the videos you generate. It is optional; without it, the videos come out with a synthesized voice.
settings.language_assistant_speaks_with: The language your assistant speaks with you. The interface is still being translated, so for now the change mainly applies to the chats.
settings.turn_each_feature_or: Turn each feature on or off. The number next to it is a <0>rough estimate</0> of credits per use, deducted from your balance.
settings.let_assistant_send_emails: Let the assistant <0>send emails</0> for me.
settings.when_off_only_creates: When off, it only creates <0>drafts</0> in your Gmail for you to review and send. Turned on, it can send it out (always asking for your confirmation first).
settings.do_not_use_my: <0>Do not use</0> my chats and files to improve {brand}.
settings.applies_from_now_while: It applies from now on and while it stays on: the content created in that period is left out forever, even if you turn it off later. Details in the <0>Privacy Policy</0>.

credits.choose_balance_between_quality: Choose the balance between quality and credit use. Stronger models spend more per chat.
credits.credits_are_usage_currency: Credits are the usage currency. Each chat consumes credits according to its size. The allowance renews every month.
credits.running_out_credits_before: Running out of credits before the month turns over? Buy an extra pack, without changing plan. The credits add to your balance and are valid for 90 days from the purchase.
